title: M08 — CRDs & Operators — Baseline
description: Tour a working operator on the Polyphone fleet: a MediaTenant CRD, two custom resources, and the tenant-operator that reconciles each into an owner-referenced child Deployment, writes .status, and cleans up behind a finalizer.
